gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-roboto: Wire-bent letters, spaced out and glossy. Roboto follows with generous round shapes and lowercase that sits close to the capitals in height, which makes it the quiet one.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-ruda: Ruda arrives with a tall x-height and a wire-thin monoline skeleton, friendly and wide-mouthed in the rounds. And Stentiga up top, spread out and luxurious, lets that body run a long page without tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-saira: Neon-glass lettering, stretched wide and glowing. And Saira underneath keeps an s you can see through, with rounded forms reaching high, so the two feel like sign and fine print.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sarpanch: Stentiga looks like neon tubing bent into letters, spread wide with crossbars matching the stems in thickness. Sarpanch sits beneath with an open lowercase e and tight ascenders, so a long passage would read compact and approachable.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Glassy, widely tracked, and refined, with an o whose sides and top match in thickness. Schibsted Grotesk takes over with big open e and a shapes and terminals that never close in, so long text stays inviting.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sen: Crossbars as thick as the stems give Stentiga its luxurious, spread-out wire look. Sen follows with tall lowercase and curved strokes that stop before turning inward, so a long passage would feel modern and light.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sintony: Stentiga's stencil-cut channel of constant weight, stretched wide, feels refined and a bit glamorous. Sintony sits next to it chunky and tall in the middle of each letter, smooth and uncluttered, like a sturdy friend beside a show-off.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sofia-sans: Neon-like and stretched wide, the heading feels luxurious. Sofia Sans stands tall in acrylic-stencil lowercase with no thick-and-thin shifts, and if the heading were made small, those spread-out letters would lose their glow.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sofia-sans-semi-c: Stentiga is the showpiece, with spread-out wire letters and wide openings that look refined and luxurious. But Sofia Sans Semi Condensed does the quiet work, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its curves inviting you in.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sono: Stentiga spreads its wire-bent letters wide, with a t whose crossbar and stem match in weight, and it looks luxurious. Sono answers with tall, loosely spaced lowercase, friendlier and more relaxed.
